title: Vacancy Permit Charge — LandlordGuard Rating Rule
content:
**Rule.** On the LandlordGuard Dwelling Fire Policy a vacancy permit requested by the landlord starts on the date of the request and runs through the day before the policy's expiration date, or for the tier's longest vacancy permit if that is shorter; its permit days are those calendar days, both the first and the last day counted.

The vacancy permit charge is the policy's term premium multiplied by the permit rate percentage divided by 100, by the charged permit days, and divided by the calendar days in the term (counted from the effective date to the expiration date), rounded half-up to the cent once, on the final figure. It is posted as one additional premium entry for the vacancy permit, dated the permit start.

The standard permit rate percentage is the tier's vacancy permit rate, and the charged permit days are the permit days themselves.

## The quantities

| Quantity | Where it comes from |
|---|---|
| Term premium | the annual premium of the current term on the policy |
| Permit rate percentage | the tier's vacancy permit rate |
| Permit days | calendar days from the request date through the day before expiration, or the tier's longest vacancy permit if fewer |
| Charged permit days | the permit days |
| Calendar days in the term | days from the effective date to the expiration date on the policy |

The multiplication and division run on unrounded figures; the only rounding is on the final charge.

## Worked figures (hypothetical policy)

Term premium 1,460.00 USD; a 365-day term expiring on 11 June; tier vacancy permit rate taken as 25 percent and longest permit as 90 days.

1. **Request on 3 March, expiration 11 June.** The days from 3 March through 10 June number 100; the tier's longest permit, 90 days, is shorter, so the permit runs from 3 March through 31 May, 90 permit days. Charge: 1,460.00 multiplied by 25 and divided by 100 gives 365.00; multiplied by 90 and divided by 365 gives 90.00 USD.
2. **Request on 1 May, expiration 11 June.** The permit runs from 1 May through 10 June, 41 permit days, fewer than 90. Charge: 365.00 multiplied by 41 and divided by 365, that is 41.00 USD.
3. **Rounding once.** Term premium 1,234.00 USD, rate taken as 20 percent, 45 permit days, 365-day term: 1,234.00 multiplied by 20 and divided by 100 is 246.80; multiplied by 45 is 11,106.00; divided by 365 is 30.4274, rounded half-up to 30.43 USD.
